long_biography.plain_text:
Car dealer Ed Napleton carried his interest in Porsche racing into the competition team based at his Westmont dealership. As team principal, he backed its entry in the Rolex 24 at Daytona, where a Cayman S won the GX class in 2013. The operation prepared cars for amateur competitors as well as professional racing, and Napleton competed in the Cayman Interseries himself.

Napleton's dealerships maintained cash reserves that allowed the group to buy additional locations during the financial crisis. Its geographical spread also served a practical purpose: customers who divided their time between Illinois and Florida could continue using the same dealership group for their cars.
